verdict.rationale: FireHydrant, an incident-management SaaS, publishes an official MCP server repository, described as "An MCP server for interacting with FireHydrant's API." Its OpenAPI document spans the API surface, including Call Routes, Permissions, Roles and Audit Events. missing for 10: agent connection and setup documentation (install, auth, client configuration), an explicit list of exposed MCP tools, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
